## Every battle tells a bigger story.

ROK Battles turns Rise of Kingdoms battle reports into data you can explore, compare and use across a growing set of community tools.

[Battle Reports](https://rokbattles.com/) · [Olympian Arena](https://rokbattles.com/olympian-arena) · [Combat Lab](https://rokbattles.com/combat-lab) · [Loot Explorer](https://rokbattles.com/loot-explorer) · [Territory Lab](https://rokbattles.com/territory-lab)
